**Measured:** 606 routes in 81 route files under `server/src/routes/`, counted by `scripts/docs/generate-route-index.mjs` from each `router.<method>(` call and resolved against the mounts in `server/src/app.ts`. Route-list digest `e8bea3be3651`; it changes exactly when a route is added, removed, renamed or remounted, so `git log -S e8bea3be3651 -- docs/api/route-index.md` finds the commit that generated this page.

**In the contract:** 62 of them. Those are the operations in [the API reference](/api/reference), and each one is a promise: it will not be removed or renamed without a deprecation cycle.

**Everything else is internal and may change without notice.** It is listed so you can see what exists, not so you can build on it. If you need one of these routes, ask for it to be added to the contract.

Withheld, engagement-specific: 2 routes in 1 file, counted above but not listed.

Withheld, serving a private product profile: 2 routes in 1 file, counted above but not listed.
